title: Every operational record has its INSERT event in the audit log
Every status change of orders, non-conformities and actions is in the audit log
The chain of changes of a field is continuous and ends in the current value
There is no DELETE event in the audit log
Every audit event points to an existing record
A corrective action has a non-conformity; origin INCIDENT if and only if it has one
The number prefix (CA/PA) matches the action type
Due dates are not before creation; the action is not created before the non-conformity
A CLOSED action records the result, date and verifier of the effectiveness check
The person verifying effectiveness is not the person responsible for the action
Dates in order: creation <= completion <= effectiveness check <= closure
Progress never decreases and reaches 100 % before the action is completed
An action closed as NOT_EFFECTIVE has a follow-up action
The current due date is not earlier than the original one
Open action past its due date (overdue action)
Progress updates are between the creation and the closure of the action
A document has at most one current revision
Revision dates are in order (issue <= effective <= review; effective <= superseded)
A revision is SUPERSEDED if and only if it has a superseded date
The approver of a revision is not its author
Every revision that is not a draft has an approver
Revisions do not overlap: each one starts the day the previous one is superseded
An aircraft record is linked to an aircraft
A controlled document has a review interval and its current revision a review date
A verification that is not CONFORM describes the discrepancy
A NON_CONFORM verification is linked to a non-conformity
A verification is not earlier than the issue of the revision verified
Current revision with its review date passed (expired document)
Every foreign key points to an existing record
Business codes are unique and follow their format
Dates and date-times have a valid ISO format
No event is later than the cut-off date (AS_OF_DATE)
No operational event is earlier than the start of the period
Every person acting on a record was employed on that date
Boolean fields only contain 0 or 1
Movements, progress updates and the audit log cannot be modified
No business record can be physically deleted
Operational records identify who created them
No logical duplicates (same content recorded twice)
Each movement type moves stock between its own pair of states
Each movement type carries its mandatory references
No stock state is ever negative (running balance)
The quantity received on a line does not exceed the quantity ordered
No receipt or promised date earlier than the order date
Material is only reserved or issued for lines of the order while it is open
Every lot issued to an order was previously received (or counted at go-live)
Serialized materials move one unit at a time with a serial number
Receipts of materials that require a certificate carry its reference
Materials counted in units (EA, KIT) only have whole quantities
The 'system' quantity of a count equals the stock calculated at that moment
Every count difference has an adjustment of the same quantity and a comment
No purchase order to a supplier after its suspension
A movement to NON_CONFORMING is linked to a 'non-conforming material' incident
No material is issued after its shelf-life expiry date
Stock below minimum (available + in quarantine) with no pending purchase order
Planned end is not earlier than the opening date
COMPLETED or CLOSED if and only if there is an actual end date
CLOSED if and only if closure date and person are recorded; closure >= actual end
CANCELLED if and only if there is a cancellation reason
ON_HOLD if and only if the order has an active hold
At most one active hold per reason on each order
A material hold names the material; a documentation hold names the document
A material hold corresponds to a real shortage when it was recorded
An order only uses revisions in force on the date they were linked
The required date of a material is within the order dates
A COMPLETED or CLOSED order received all its material, net of returns
Order dates are within the maintenance contract of the aircraft
An order is not closed while a CRITICAL non-conformity linked to it is open
Holds are within the dates of their order
CLOSED or CANCELLED if and only if there is a closure date, not before detection
A CLOSED non-conformity records who closed it and the measures adopted
CRITICAL and MAJOR non-conformities have a containment action
CRITICAL and MAJOR non-conformities have a root-cause analysis once investigated
A CLOSED non-conformity has all its corrective actions closed or cancelled
A CLOSED non-conformity (except observations) has at least one corrective action
If a non-conformity names an order and an aircraft, the aircraft is the order's
A non-conformity is linked to at least one record (aircraft, order, revision, material, supplier or PO line)
The root-cause analysis is after detection and before closure
With 5 Whys, why_1 is filled in and the chain has no gaps
With Ishikawa, the 6M category is filled in
Open non-conformity past its target closure date
The category is consistent with the linked records (SUP->supplier, INV->material, DOC/TRC->document or order)
